items.headline: FDA authorizes first fully robotic blood-draw device
items.summary: The FDA authorized a robotic device called Aletta that can draw blood from a patient's arm on its own, without a person doing the needle stick. In FDA-reviewed testing it succeeded at rates as good as or better than trained phlebotomists, and one supervisor can now oversee several devices at once.
items.why_it_matters: It offers a validated way to ease a persistent phlebotomist shortage and speed up basic blood testing across busy clinics.
